title: MAT
summary: Official Derivative MAT overview for material operators that apply shaders to SOP or 3D Geometry Object surfaces, including object Display-page material assignment, Phong/GLSL/TOP shader inputs, normals and texture coordinates, PBR with Environment Light COMP, and common MAT types.
guidance: Use this article when selecting a material family or explaining how MATs attach to renderable geometry.
Apply MATs through the Material parameter on the Display page of Object Components or through compatible material workflows such as Material SOP when appropriate.
Phong MAT and GLSL MAT can use TOP inputs and GLSL pixel/vertex shader programs; geometry usually needs normals for specular shading and texture coordinates for maps.
Use PBR MAT with Environment Light COMP for physically based material workflows, including Substance TOP assets loaded from .sbsar files.
Use Constant MAT for unlit flat color, Depth MAT for depth-pass output, Line MAT for edges/points, and Point Sprite MAT for point-sprite geometry.
